input.question: When was Egg Rock Light constructed?

documents.text:
Wildlife Refuge. Accessibility: The lighthouse is not open to the public and is best viewed by boat. Station established: 1875 Present lighthouse built: 1920 Automated: 1976 Construction material: Brick, wood Other buildings still standing: 1904 fog signal building, oil house, boathouse, generator house Height of tower: 40 feet Height of focal plane: 64 feet Original optic: Fifth-order Fresnel lens Present optic: VRB-25 (below) Characteristic: Flashing red every five seconds Fog signal: Two blasts every 30 seconds Previous lighthouse: Bear Island

In 1920, the present Egg Rock Light was constructed to replace the original structure, which had served since 1875. The new lighthouse was built using brick and wood, and it stands 40 feet tall, with a focal plane height of 64 feet.
